wats.definition: n. a telephone line; long distance service at fixed rates for fixed zones; an acronym for wide area telephone service
wats.translation: abbr. 长途电话服务（Wide Area Telecommunications Service）

watson.definition:
n. United States telephone engineer who assisted Alexander Graham Bell in his experiments (1854-1934)
n. United States psychologist considered the founder of behavioristic psychology (1878-1958)
n. United States geneticist who (with Crick in 1953) helped discover the helical structure of DNA (born in 1928)

watson's operation.translation: [医] 瓦生氏手术(睑内翻手术)

watson-crick.translation: a. 【生物化学】瓦特生—克里克理论的(指美国生物学家瓦特生和英国生物学家克里克提出的双螺旋线和中心法则等遗传理论)

watson-schwartz test.translation: [医] 瓦-施二氏试验(检卟啉胆色素原)

watsonian.translation: a. 华生式的(指像福尔摩斯的助手华生一样外行的)

watsonians.translation: (watsonian 的复数) adj. 华生式的(指像福尔摩斯的助手华生一样外行的)
